title: Bloody PVP
description: A PVP resource pack which has a bloody theme to it.
body:
A simple minecraft PVP pack which makes common pvp items red.
This includes:
- Cobwebs
- Low fire 
- Respawn Anchors
- Arrow
- Bow
- Crossbow
- Netherite Sword
- Diamond Sword
- End Crystals
- Ender Pearls
- Experience Bottle
- Golden apple
- Iron sword
- Gold sword
